cohort: 259 women (26.66 ± 4.57 years) residing in urban areas of Bangladesh who were attending healthcare delivery centers
finding: The study found a 60.6% prevalence of PPD among urban mothers in Bangladesh and identified several significant factors associated with PPD, including high monthly family income, income dissatisfaction, up to two gravidities, pregnancy-related complications, increased antenatal care visits, and higher childbirth expenses.
